items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: Bob Sher, who is also from my hometown, would sit at the piano and show you how to reharmonize these guitar symbols into chords

ctx.x: He had the early fake books which were the pictures of the Library of Congress cards. And that’s what we were working — this is pre Real Book, right? Where you had to buy the books surreptitiously, it was illegal to sell the book. You had to go to the black market to get the book you know. So and everybody is afraid they’re going to get arrested because they’re buying this book illegally. It’s hilarious. But and that was an amazing class, Bob Sher, who is also from my hometown, would sit at the piano and show you…
